paragraphs: Sectri sells a cybersecurity program management platform that holds assessments, risks, projects, tasks, documents and evidence in one system of record instead of separate tracks. The site frames the problem as security work spread across tools and spreadsheets, with priorities unclear and progress hard to show to leadership, auditors, insurers, or regulators.

The program is described as a lifecycle that assesses current state, ranks risks and gaps, runs the work with owners and evidence, then reports progress. The platform is paired with the Sectri Alliance, described as a community of organizations facing the same challenges, offering peer benchmarking and monthly collaboration calls. Frameworks and requirements named on the page include the NIST Cybersecurity Framework (CSF), CIS Critical Security Controls, HIPAA, and CJIS.

A testimonial on the page is attributed to a County Information Security Officer, and a case study quotes the National Association of Counties on counties aligning to industry best practices. Sectri was founded in 2017 by former public sector and critical infrastructure security leaders and is based in the United States.

quote.text: Sectri turns scattered cybersecurity efforts into a single, repeatable program.
